segments.name: Power Transmission
segments.description: Makes elastomer drive belts and related components for industrial, automotive aftermarket and personal mobility applications.
segments.evidence: Our Power Transmission segment includes elastomer drive belts and related components used to efficiently transfer power in a broad range of applications.

segments.name: Fluid Power
segments.description: Makes hoses, tubing and fittings that convey hydraulic fluid at high pressures for mobile and stationary applications.
segments.evidence: Our Fluid Power segment includes hoses, tubing and fittings designed to convey hydraulic fluid at high pressures in both mobile and stationary applications, and other high-pressure and fluid transfer hoses.

revenueModel.text: Aftermarket channel customers and original equipment manufacturers pay for power transmission and fluid power components, with most revenue from aftermarket channels.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer a broad portfolio of products to diverse aftermarket channel customers, and to original equipment manufacturers ("OEM") as specified components, with the majority of our revenue coming from aftermarket channels.

changes.text: In 2024 the company deconsolidated its Russian subsidiary, ending that business.
changes.evidence: As of September 28, 2024, we deconsolidated the Russian subsidiary upon loss of control and recognized a deconsolidation loss.
